9	/-!
10	# F5 — `isDivRepClassify_pull` from the per-chart clause, and the whole package from U2
11	
12	`Picard/DivRepAffPullField.lean` defines `pull` and `Picard/DivRepAffPullNat.lean` proves
13	`pull_naturality`.  The third field of `DivRepAffinePullback.ofPull` is
14	`isDivRepClassify_pull`, and this file discharges it — **from the same hypothesis
15	`IsCompatible` already needs**:
16	
17	> `IsChartClause U` : for every chart `(i, j)` and every `ω : R_Z(i,j) →ₐ[k] S`, the chart
18	> pull `divRepPullAt U i j ω` satisfies `IsDivRepClassify` for the chart morphism
19	> `Spec ω ≫ ChartMap i j`.
20	
21	That is precisely the hypothesis `isCompatible_of_isDivRepClassify_divRepPullAt`
22	(`Picard/DivRepAffPullbackReduce.lean`) consumes, i.e. the DDR9-U ε-identity in clause
23	form.  So the two obligations the round-5 framing listed side by side —
24	`isDivRepClassify_pull` **and** `IsCompatible` — are **one** obligation, and this file
25	proves that:
26	
27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepChartFamily.IsChartClause` — the named U2 interface.
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isDivRepClassify_divRepPullValue` — **the third field**: the glued
29	  pulled class satisfies the characterizing clause for the morphism it came from.
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divRepAffinePullback_ofChartClause` — **a producer of
31	  `DivRepAffinePullback` from `IsChartClause` alone**, hence (with
32	  `DivRepAffinePullback.representableBy`) of the divisor-representability endpoint.
33	
34	**Why the clause is local on the base, which is the whole content.** `IsDivRepClassify F₀ v`
35	quantifies over tower tests `T` carrying a certified representative of `F₀`'s restriction
36	and a chart framing of its ε pair, and concludes an equality of morphisms out of `Spec T`.
37	Both the hypothesis data and the conclusion restrict along `T → T ⊗ …`; and a chart framing
38	over `T` together with the atlas factorization over the spanning family `f` gives, on each
39	`Localization.Away (f t)`-overlap, two chart presentations of the same morphism.  The
40	already-landed `pullback_chart_divClassifyClause_compat` is exactly that comparison, so the
41	`Scheme.Cover.hom_ext` chase is the same one `exists_isDivRepClassify` runs — this file
42	runs it against the *pulled* class rather than a classified one.
43	
44	**What this does NOT do.** It produces no `IsChartClause`.  U2 — the ε-identity at the
45	universal point — is still unproved, and per the roadmap leaf it is gated on the G-4
46	certificate discharge (`ThetaGeneratorSeed.certifiedFamily` wants a global `IsCertified`
47	over the chart ring).  What changes is the *shape* of the remaining debt: a producer of the
48	divisor-representability endpoint now owes exactly one statement, stated in one place, with
49	no cover bookkeeping left around it.
50	-/

20	/-!
21	# U2's class half: the no-go DOES reach the Zariski-local pin, and its input narrows
22	
23	`Picard/DivRepChartClassUnivAny.lean:223-231` carries a warning that the roadmap leaf
24	`…divrep.u2` and three inbox items have since quoted as the leaf's price:
25	
26	> the hypothesis `HasCertifiedAdaptation` is **refuted** by
27	> `forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling` … So this theorem is a sound *reduction* whose
28	> hypothesis may be false; do not read it as "U2 is one certificate away".
29	
30	The warning is correct, and **it does reach the Zariski-local pin as well** — but only in a
31	NARROWED form, and the narrowing is what this file records.
32	
33	## What the no-go does and does not need
34	
35	*A first draft of this file claimed the no-go could not reach the pin, on the grounds that no
36	lemma carries `¬ IsLocallyCertified` and that the only landed implication runs
37	`isLocallyCertified_of_isCertified`, i.e. refuted-side → pin.  Both halves of that are true and
38	the conclusion drawn from them was wrong; the correction is kept in place of the claim because
39	the reasoning is the reusable part.*
40	
41	No bridge lemma is needed, because `forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling`
42	(`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffStrict.lean:127`) takes its base ring as a **section variable** and
43	its system as an implicit.  It therefore instantiates directly at
44	`R := Localization.Away r` with the **pulled** system, which is exactly the binder
45	`IsLocallyCertified` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyZar.lean:71`) uses.  A no-go stated over section
46	variables is a *schema*, not a statement about one ring, and "the pin quantifies over a
47	different ring" buys nothing against it.
48	
49	What the away form *does* buy is a strictly smaller refuting input.  To kill the pin one now
50	needs the two straddling witnesses **inside a single fibre** — the existential picks `r` with
51	`r ∉ p`, so witnesses lying over `p` survive whichever `r` is offered, but witnesses at
52	unrelated primes can be shrunk away.  Global straddling refutes
53	`HasCertifiedAdaptation`; only one-fibre straddling refutes the pin.  Two sibling headers state
54	this in prose already (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarC1.lean:32`,
55	`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarVerdict.lean:25`: no Zariski shrink separates the witnesses).
56	
57	## What this file lands
58	
59	The per-prime route already in the tree
60	(`ThetaGeneratorSeed.isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_certified_adaptation`,
61	`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarPointwise.lean:162`) produces the pin from away-localized
62	certificates.  This file instantiates it at the high-window universal seed, so that U2's
63	class half is stated at the binder a producer can actually target, and names the refuting
64	input that binder still admits.
65	
66	## Main declarations
67	
68	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PointwiseAchiever.ForallPrimeAwayCertified` — the away form of the
69	  class obligation, stated so that the ring each adaptation lives over is visible.
70	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PointwiseAchiever.divFamZarUnivOfForallPrimeAway` — the `DivFamZar`
71	  class at the universal point from it, with no certificate over `R_Z` in the input.
72	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ThetaGeneratorSeed.isLocallyCertified_of_isCertified_not_conversely`
73	  — the direction record: the refuted side implies the pin.  Kept, with its name's `_not_
74	  conversely` read as a statement about the *implication*, not as a claim that the no-go
75	  fails to reach the pin — it does reach it, by instantiation at the away ring.
76	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ThetaGeneratorSeed.side_straddle_gives_chart_separated_pieces` — the
77	  probe's correct shape: opposite `side` values already separate the charts, so what is
78	  measurable is the `side` function, not a support locus.
79	
80	## What this does NOT do, stated exactly
81	
82	It produces **no certificate**, at no prime, so **no gate clears** and `rep` remains
83	undischarged.  It does not make the class half easier; it makes the *refuting* input harder,
84	which is a smaller and less exciting claim than the one this file's first draft made.
85	
86	**The away hypothesis has no witness at any prime**, here or anywhere in the tree, and it is
87	refutable exactly when the universal seed's support straddles within one fibre.
88	
89	**THE PROBE THIS SEAM STILL OWES, in the shape that is worth running.**  Nothing in the tree
90	compares `univSeed`'s support to the pinned charts, and the leaf is unpriced in both directions
91	until something does — two rounds have argued about whether a refutation reaches its target
92	instead of checking whether its antecedent holds.  But "does `univSeed` straddle?" is the wrong
93	spelling, and `side_straddle_gives_chart_separated_pieces` below says why:
94	
95	* every seed **piece** is confined to one pinned chart *by construction* — `piece_le` is
96	  `basicOpen_le` at `relPinnedChart C R π (D.side z)`, so this is a fact about the *type*
97	  `ThetaGeneratorSeed` and there is nothing seed-specific to measure;
98	* but `localEquations` builds a **pointed** cover, one member per point, with `side` a function
99	  *of the point*.  So the support locus may straddle both charts globally while every piece is
100	  chart-confined.  Those are different statements.
101	
102	The measurement is therefore about the `side` **function**, not about a support computation:
103	*do two points of the support take opposite sides?*  That is where a lane should spend the
104	round.  (Established by `review-ajcr`, inbox `I-1003`; re-derived here rather than taken on
105	report, and the transport is the theorem below.)
106	
107	**Neither direction is settled by any of this, and the asymmetry is easy to mis-quote.**
108	Per-piece chart-confinement together with a `side` *function* **permits** global straddling; it
109	does not **produce** it.  So "the seed is chart-confined" must not be read as "it straddles",
110	and equally must not be read as "it cannot" — the first is what a producer needs ruled out, the
111	second is what a producer would need proved, and this file supplies neither.
112	
113	**One further thing unmeasured here, and it may be decisive** (`review-ajcr`, `I-1003`):
114	`ThetaGeneratorSeed` types its pieces *into* the pinned charts, which is the shape protection
115	`I-0492` clause 3 names as what made the earlier cheaper option vacuous.  If U2's class half
116	routes through the seed at all, it is on the **chart-typed** side of the widening by
117	construction, and the away-localization argument above inherits that confinement.  Were that so,
118	the retraction at the top of this file would have a *structural* cause rather than a proof-level
119	one.  Not measured here; worth testing before another round is spent on the away route.
120	
121	**Do NOT read the pinned-chart geometry as an obstruction.**  The certificate assemblers
122	(`DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning`, `Picard/DivSchemeCertUniv.lean:104`)
123	consume a *swallow-or-miss* clause, and a **disjoint** piece is its harmless branch:
124	`forall_noLeak_of_forall_subset_or_disjoint` accepts it, and
125	`forall_subset_or_disjoint_of_isPreconnected` (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarConn.lean:128`) already
126	produces the disjunction for a connected support.  The `∀ j, supp ⊆ pieces j` shape of
127	`forall_noLeak_of_forall_supportLocus_subset` (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarTube.lean:142`) is a
128	convenience wrapper, and it is the wrapper — not the interface — that is degenerate on a cover
129	with two disjoint pieces.  This paragraph replaces a guard theorem that audited the wrapper and
130	inferred a limit on the assembler; the inference was wrong and the theorem is withdrawn.
131	-/

261	noncomputable abbrev univSystem (hb : 0 < windowBound pi hpi) :
262	    (relCurve C RZ).LocalEquations :=
263	  (univSeed C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j hO hchi hb).localEquations
264	    (isGenerator_univSeed C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j hO hchi hb)

266	/-- **The per-prime away hypothesis**, named: at every prime of the chart ring some basic
267	open carries a certified chart-typed adaptation of the *pulled* universal system.
268	
269	This is the hypothesis that replaces `HasCertifiedAdaptation`.  It is not an instance of
270	`forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling`'s `∀`: that quantifier ranges over adaptations of the
271	system over `R_Z` itself, while every adaptation here lives over a `Localization.Away r` and
272	adapts the pullback along `relCurveMap`. -/
273	def ForallPrimeAwayCertified [IsNoetherianRing RZ] (hb : 0 < windowBound pi hpi) : Prop :=
274	  ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum RZ, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
275	    haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C RZ (Localization.Away r)) :=
276	      isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C RZ (Localization.Away r) r
277	    ∃ A : DivisorAdaptation C (Localization.Away r) pi
278	        ((univSystem C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j hO hchi hb).pullback
279	          (relCurveMap C RZ (Localization.Away r))
280	          (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
281	            (relCurveMap C RZ (Localization.Away r))
282	            (univSystem C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j hO hchi hb))),
283	      A.IsCertified g
284	
285	/-- **U2's class half from the away hypothesis** — the locally certified class over the
286	`Z(♦)`-chart ring, with no certificate over `R_Z` anywhere in the input. -/
287	noncomputable def divFamZarUnivOfForallPrimeAway [IsNoetherianRing RZ]
288	    (hb : 0 < windowBound pi hpi)
289	    (h : ForallPrimeAwayCertified C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j hO hchi hb) :
290	    DivFamZar C RZ pi g :=
291	  (univSeed C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j hO hchi hb).divFamZar_of_forall_prime_away_certified
292	    (isGenerator_univSeed C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j hO hchi hb)
293	    (fun p => by
294	      obtain ⟨r, hrp, A, hA⟩ := h p
295	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C RZ (Localization.Away r)) :=
296	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C RZ (Localization.Away r) r
297	      exact ⟨r, hrp, ⟨_, A, hA⟩, Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl _⟩)

64	
65	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
66	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
67	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] {a : ℕ}
68	
69	/-- **A theta generator seed for a submodule `K ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(Θᵃ))`** (worksheet §3.4.1): at
70	every point `z` of the relative curve, a pinned chart side containing `z`, a basic-open
71	neighbourhood piece `D(h z)` of the chart, and a global section `sec z ∈ K` — the
72	candidate local generator.  The two `lm:ctn` clauses on a seed are
73	`ThetaGeneratorSeed.IsGenerator`. -/
74	structure ThetaGeneratorSeed (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
75	    [Algebra k R] (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite π] (a : ℕ)
76	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) : Type u where
77	  /-- The pinned chart side of the piece at `z`. -/
78	  side : relCurve C R → Bool
79	  /-- The basic-open generator of the piece at `z`. -/
80	  h : ∀ z : relCurve C R, Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π (side z))
81	  /-- The point lies in its piece. -/
82	  mem_basicOpen : ∀ z : relCurve C R, z ∈ (relCurve C R).basicOpen (h z)
83	  /-- The candidate local generator at `z`. -/
84	  sec : relCurve C R → relThetaSections C R π a
85	  /-- The candidate generators are drawn from `K`. -/
86	  sec_mem : ∀ z, sec z ∈ K
87	
88	namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed
89	
90	variable {K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)} (D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R π a K)
91	
92	/-- The neighbourhood piece at `z`: the basic open `D(h z)` of the pinned chart. -/
93	noncomputable def piece (z : relCurve C R) : (relCurve C R).Opens :=
94	  (relCurve C R).basicOpen (D.h z)
95	
96	lemma mem_piece (z : relCurve C R) : z ∈ D.piece z := D.mem_basicOpen z
97	
98	lemma piece_le (z : relCurve C R) : D.piece z ≤ relPinnedChart C R π (D.side z) :=
99	  (relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (D.h z)
100	
101	/-- The pieces are affine (basic opens of the affine pinned charts). -/
102	lemma isAffineOpen_piece (z : relCurve C R) : IsAffineOpen (D.piece z) :=
103	  (isAffineOpen_relPinnedChart C R π (D.side z)).basicOpen (D.h z)
104	
105	/-- **Flatness of the piece sections over the test ring** (the (iii)⟹(i) licence). -/
106	theorem flat_sections_piece (z : relCurve C R) :
107	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) :=
108	  flat_sections_basicOpen R (isAffineOpen_relPinnedChart C R π (D.side z))
109	    (flat_sections_relPinnedChart C R π (D.side z)) (D.h z)
110	
111	/-- **The candidate local equation at `z`**: the side component of the chosen generator,
112	restricted to the piece. -/
113	noncomputable def eqn (z : relCurve C R) : Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) :=
114	  relThetaResSide a (D.side z) (D.piece_le z) (D.sec z)
115	
116	/-- **The `lm:ctn` clauses on a seed** (Kleiman (ii)⟹(iii) packaged as its output, plus
117	the fibrewise-regularity input of (iii)⟹(i)):
118	
119	* `dvd` — the chosen generator generates the subsheaf `K·𝒪` on its piece: the side
120	  component of every element of `K` is a multiple of the equation (the Nakayama
121	  neighbourhood clause, produced fibrewise by the P-fib achiever +
122	  `exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective`);
123	* `fibre_regular` — the equation is a nonzerodivisor in every residue-field fibre of
124	  every basic sub-open of the piece (produced by P-fib: the fibre of the equation is a
125	  nonzero section of an integral curve over `κ(p)`).
126	
127	Both clauses are stated relative to the test ring only, so the DD-4 base-field-transport
128	seam moves a single boundary (spec-dd-r §7 risk 2). -/
129	structure IsGenerator : Prop where
130	  dvd : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) ⦃ψ : relThetaSections C R π a⦄, ψ ∈ K →
131	    relThetaResSide a (D.side z) (D.piece_le z) ψ ∈ Ideal.span {D.eqn z}
132	  fibre_regular : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (p : PrimeSpectrum R)
133	      (f : Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z)),
134	    ((relCurve C R).resHom ((relCurve C R).basicOpen_le f) (D.eqn z) ⊗ₜ[R]
135	        (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) ∈
136	      nonZeroDivisors
137	        (Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen f) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField)

341	/-! ### The DDR-3 deliverable: the local-equation system and its adaptation -/
342	
343	variable (D)
344	
345	/-- **The local-equation system of a theta generator seed** (the DDR-3 family): the
346	pieces are the pointed cover, the equations are the side components of the chosen
347	generators; regularity is the germ-regularity law, the overlap units are the ratio
348	law. -/
349	noncomputable def localEquations [IsNoetherianRing R] (hD : D.IsGenerator) :
350	    (relCurve C R).LocalEquations where
351	  cover := { opens := D.piece, mem_opens := D.mem_piece }
352	  eqn := D.eqn
353	  regular := fun z _ hy => D.germ_eqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors hD z hy
354	  ratio_isUnit := fun z z' => D.exists_ratioUnit hD z z'
355	
356	@[simp]
357	lemma localEquations_cover_opens [IsNoetherianRing R] (hD : D.IsGenerator)
358	    (z : relCurve C R) : (D.localEquations hD).cover.opens z = D.piece z := rfl
359

361	lemma localEquations_eqn [IsNoetherianRing R] (hD : D.IsGenerator) (z : relCurve C R) :
362	    (D.localEquations hD).eqn z = D.eqn z := rfl
363

365	DD-1 extraction (`exists_divisorAdaptation`); no anchor field of `DivisorAdaptation` is
366	consumed here (DD-2 carrier-surgery freeze discipline). -/
367	noncomputable def divisorAdaptation [IsNoetherianRing R] (hD : D.IsGenerator) :
368	    DivisorAdaptation C R π (D.localEquations hD) :=
369	  (exists_divisorAdaptation C R π (D.localEquations hD)).some

378	      = Ideal.span {((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.piece z) z (D.mem_piece z)).hom

380	
381	/-- **The germ divisibility law**: at any point `y` of the piece of `z`, the germ of the
382	side component of every element of `K` lies in the span of the germ of the equation. -/
383	theorem germ_relThetaResSide_mem_span [IsNoetherianRing R] (hD : D.IsGenerator)
384	    (z : relCurve C R) {ψ : relThetaSections C R π a} (hψ : ψ ∈ K)
385	    {y : relCurve C R} (hy : y ∈ D.piece z) :
386	    ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.piece z) y hy).hom
387	        (relThetaResSide a (D.side z) (D.piece_le z) ψ)
388	      ∈ Ideal.span
389	        {((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.piece z) y hy).hom (D.eqn z)} := by
390	  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (hD.dvd z hψ)
391	  rw [hc, map_mul]
392	  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)

398	    K ≤ (D.localEquations hD).vanishingSubmodule R

400	      (relThetaCocycle C R π a) := by

The census is complete. All items gathered; report follows.

## 1. `univSeed`

**Definition** — `AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivRepChartClassUniv.lean:131-134`, namespace `AlgebraicGeometry.PointwiseAchiever`:

```lean
noncomputable abbrev univSeed (hb : 0 < windowBound pi hpi) :
    ThetaGeneratorSeed C RZ pi (windowM_choice pi hpi g)
      (divUniversalSeedK C pi hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j) :=
  highWindowPointwiseGeneratorSeed C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j hO hchi hb
```

with `RZ` the file-local notation (`:125-127`) for `DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j`.

**It has no `supportLocus` of its own.** `supportLocus` (`Picard/SupportTube.lean:131`, `def supportLocus : Set X := (d.unitLocus : Set X)ᶜ` where `unitLocus := ⨆ x, X.basicOpen (d.eqn x)`) is a field-free function of a `LocalEquations`, not of a seed. The seed reaches one only through `localEquations` (`Picard/DivSchemeFamily.lean:349`), which needs the generator clause:

```lean
noncomputable def localEquations [IsNoetherianRing R] (hD : D.IsGenerator) :
    (relCurve C R).LocalEquations where
  cover := { opens := D.piece, mem_opens := D.mem_piece }
  eqn := D.eqn
  ...
```

So the probe's object is `(univSeed …).localEquations (isGenerator_univSeed …)`, which the tree already names: `PointwiseAchiever.univSystem`, `Picard/DivRepChartClassUnivZarLocal.lean:261-264`.

**Unfolding chain, all measured:** `univSeed` = `highWindowPointwiseGeneratorSeed` (`Picard/DivSchemeHighWindowPointwiseGenerator.lean:76`) = `pointwiseGeneratorSeed … (pointwiseSeedRDN_of_highWindow …)` (`Picard/DivSchemeSeedUnivPointwiseGenerator.lean:258`) = `ThetaGeneratorSeed.productCutter (pointwiseBaseSeed …) …` (`Picard/DivSchemeRedesignSeedUnivProduct.lean:43`), and `productCutter` sets `side := D.side`, so the seed's side function is `pointwiseBaseSeed`'s, namely `pointwiseSide` (`Picard/DivSchemeSeedUnivPointwiseGenerator.lean:202`):

```lean
noncomputable def pointwiseSide (z : relCurve C RZ) : Bool :=
  (exists_mem_relPinnedChart (C := C) (π := π) z).choose
```
(`Picard/DivSchemeSeedUnivPointwise.lean:88`)

**This is decisive for the probe as stated.** `pointwiseSide` is a `Classical.choose` off `exists_mem_relPinnedChart` (`Picard/DivSchemeSeedUnivGen.lean:63`, proved from `relCover_sup`), so the side of a point is not computable from the geometry — it is whatever choice extracted. Any attempt to show two support points take *opposite* sides (the shape `DivRepChartClassUnivZarLocal.lean:208` prescribes) has to reason about `Classical.choose`, and there is no lemma in the tree pinning `pointwiseSide` at any point.

**All files mentioning `univSeed`** (four, matching the row):
- `Picard/DivRepChartClassUniv.lean` — defines it (`:131`), `isGenerator_univSeed` (`:137`), the ε-identity `divFamEps_highWindow_eq_universal_pair` (`:166`), existential form (`:200`), `divFamZarUniv` (`:213`). All consume a certificate `hc`; none touches support.
- `Picard/DivRepChartClassUnivFree.lean` — same statements with `hb` replaced by `g ≠ 0` (`:153, :170, :183`).
- `Picard/DivRepChartClassUnivAny.lean` — `:232` weakens `hc` to `HasCertifiedAdaptation`; `:261` `divFamZarUnivOfHasCertifiedAdaptation`. Carries the refutation warning at `:223-231`.
- `Picard/DivRepChartClassUnivZarLocal.lean` — `univSystem` (`:261`), `ForallPrimeAwayCertified` (`:273`), `divFamZarUnivOfForallPrimeAway` (`:287`), and the prose owing the probe (`:89-119`).

None compares support to charts. Confirmed.

## 2. The pinned charts

`V₀`/`V₁` are fields of `Scheme.AffineTwoCover` (`Picard/AffineTwoCover.lean:51-63`). The pinned pair is `relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)`: `fiberTwoCover` at `Cohomology/RigidEngine4Relative.lean:75` (`V₀ := fiberChart₀ π = π⁻¹D₊(X₀)`, `V₁ := fiberChart₁ π`), base-changed by `relCover` (`Cohomology/RelativeTwoCover.lean:128`, `:= D.pullbackProd R`, preimages under the first projection).

Side-indexed spelling, `Picard/DivSchemeFamilySide.lean:115`:
```lean
noncomputable def relPinnedChart : Bool → (relCurve C R).Opens
  | false => (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
  | true  => (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁
```
A second, `rfl`-equal spelling `pinnedChartOfSide` (a `bif`) sits at `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean:196`; `AffAdaptation.pinnedChartOfSide_eq` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffTheta.lean:153`) reconciles them.

"A point outside V₀ and a point outside V₁" is spelled, in both straddling theorems, as two set-membership negations at the coercion:
```lean
(hx₀ : x ∉ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ : Set (relCurve C R)))
(hy₁ : y ∉ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ : Set (relCurve C R)))
```
Note the pairing: `x` off `V₀`, `y` off `V₁` — one witness per chart, and they may be distinct points. `relPinnedChart` does *not* appear in the hypotheses; only the raw `relCover … .V₀/.V₁`.

## 3. The two straddling theorems, verbatim

`AlgebraicGeometry.forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling`, `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffStrict.lean:127-134`. Section binders at `:109-111`: `{k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom]`, `{R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]`, `{pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]`.

```lean
theorem forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling
    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    (hconn : _root_.IsPreconnected d.supportLocus)
    {x y : relCurve C R} (hx : x ∈ d.supportLocus) (hy : y ∈ d.supportLocus)
    (hx₀ : x ∉ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ : Set (relCurve C R)))
    (hy₁ : y ∉ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ : Set (relCurve C R))) :
    ∀ (A : DivisorAdaptation C R pi d) (n : ℕ), ¬ A.IsCertified n :=
  fun A _ => A.not_isCertified_of_isPreconnected_of_witnesses hconn hx hy hx₀ hy₁
```

The roadmap's "takes its base ring as a SECTION VARIABLE" is accurate — `R` is a section variable, and `d` is implicit, so the schema instantiates at `Localization.Away r` with the pulled system. Its engine is `DivisorAdaptation.not_isCertified_of_isPreconnected_of_witnesses` (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarVerdict.lean:62`), which runs through `supportLocus_subset_chart_of_isCertified` (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarC1.lean:131`) → `supportLocus_subset_chart_of_isPreconnected` (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarConn.lean:149`), whose upgrade step consumes `relCover_sup` (`V₀ ⊔ V₁ = ⊤`).

`AlgebraicGeometry.AffAdaptation.isEmpty_chartTyping_of_straddling`, `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffTheta.lean:658-667`. Namespace `AffAdaptation` (opened `:139`); section binders `:132-142`, note `{π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]` and the ambient `(A : AffAdaptation D d) (τ : …) (a : ℕ)` — but `D` here is the *theorem's own* explicit binder, shadowing:

```lean
theorem isEmpty_chartTyping_of_straddling (D : AffCoverData C R) (j : D.index)
    {x y : relCurve C R} (hxj : x ∈ D.pieces j) (hyj : y ∈ D.pieces j)
    (hx₀ : x ∉ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ : Set (relCurve C R)))
    (hy₁ : y ∉ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ : Set (relCurve C R))) :
    IsEmpty (ChartTyping C R π D) := by
```

Both witnesses must lie in **one piece** `j` — this is about a widened `AffCoverData`, not about `d.supportLocus` at all. `ChartTyping` is `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean:204` (`side : D.index → Bool`, `piece_le : ∀ j, D.pieces j ≤ pinnedChartOfSide C R π (side j)`).

## 4. `IsLocallyCertified`, `divFamZarSetoid`, `DivFamZar`

`Picard/DivisorFamilyZar.lean:71-80` (binders `:60-62`: `C : Over (Spec (.of k))`, `(R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]`, `(π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsAffineHom π]`):

```lean
def IsLocallyCertified (n : ℕ) (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) : Prop :=
  ∃ (m : ℕ) (g : Fin m → R), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤ ∧
    ∀ i : Fin m,
      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away (g i)) π n,
        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) d))
```

`:224-229` and `:235`:
```lean
def divFamZarSetoid : Setoid {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations //
    IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} where
  r d₁ d₂ := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁.1 d₂.1
  iseqv :=
    ⟨fun d => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl d.1,
     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩

def DivFamZar : Type u := Quotient (divFamZarSetoid C R π n)
```

The `CertifiedDivisorFamily` inside `IsLocallyCertified` is the chart-typed one (it carries a `DivisorAdaptation`, which extends `FinCoverData`), which is why the no-go instantiates at the away ring — as `DivRepChartClassUnivZarLocal.lean:41-47` states, correctly.

## 5. Nothing computes, bounds, or hypothesises `univSeed`'s support relative to the pinned charts

Searched case-insensitively for `straddl`, `supportLocus`, `support`, `univSeed`, `univSystem` across all of `AlgebraicJacobian/`. The complete list of declarations whose name mentions straddling is four: `forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling`, `exists_affAdaptation_isCertified_of_straddling`, `isEmpty_chartTyping_of_straddling`, `side_straddle_gives_chart_separated_pieces`. None mentions `univSeed`. No declaration anywhere takes `univSeed`/`univSystem` and says anything about `supportLocus`. The row's claim stands.

**Two near misses worth pricing before a lane starts, both landed and both about a general seed, hence applicable to `univSeed`:**

- `ThetaGeneratorSeed.exists_matrix_opens_supportLocus_subset_twisted_chartInter` (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarFibreAvoid.lean:355-365`): for **any** generator seed, at any base prime `p`, there is a `GL₂(k)` twist `M` and a base neighbourhood `V ∋ p` with `base⁻¹(V) ∩ (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ⊆ (twistedRelCover C R π M).V₀ ⊓ .V₁`. Proved from the seed's own `fibre_regular` clause — no certificate. It is about `twistedRelCover` (`Cohomology/TwistedFiberTwoCover.lean:81`, `= relCover C R (twistedFiberTwoCover π M)`), not the pinned `fiberTwoCover`, so it does **not** answer the probe; it says the support is chart-confinable after a coordinate change, locally on the base. This is the closest thing in the tree to the measurement, and it cuts *toward* non-straddling in the twisted charts while saying nothing at `M = 1`. Requires `[Infinite k]` (section variable at `:270`).
- `PointwiseAchiever.supportLocus_ncard_residueFibreLocalEquations_pointwiseGeneratorSeed_le` (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarFibreAvoid.lean:408`): the residue-fibre support of `pointwiseGeneratorSeed` — i.e. of `univSeed` up to the RD-N argument — has `ncard ≤ g` at every prime. A finiteness bound on the fibre support, not a chart comparison. Note its `RZ` is the `seedChartRing` notation (`Picard/DivSchemeRedesignCarvePin.lean:57`), which is an `abbrev` unfolding to the same `DivCarveChartRing` as `DivRepChartClassUniv`'s `RZ`, with `b₂` in the `(windowS + windowM)` spelling — matching.

Also relevant: `IsPreconnected d.supportLocus`, the no-go's first hypothesis, is nowhere established for any seed. So even granting the two witnesses, the refutation needs a third input nobody holds.

## 6. `ChartRing` vs `univSeed`'s ring — the probe is **not** decision-grade as written

`ChartRing` is **not a global definition**. It is a file-local notation in `Picard/DivRepAffPullClause.lean:98-101`:

```lean
local notation "ChartRing" => fun i j =>
  DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j
```

(`DivCarveChartRing` itself: `Picard/DivSchemeFamilyUniv.lean:55`, `abbrev … := PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j ⧸ divCarveIdeal k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j`.) A separate `ChartRing k d r J` in `Picard/GrassmannianScheme.lean` is an unrelated Grassmannian chart ring — different object, same name.

`IsChartClause` (`Picard/DivRepAffPullClause.lean:119-127`) quantifies over `U : ∀ i j, DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g`, i.e. over `DivFamZar C (PairChartRing … ⧸ divCarveIdeal … b1 (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j) pi g`.

**The mismatch:** `DivRepAffPullClause.lean`'s section binder for `b2` (`:89-91`) is a basis of `divisorSections k ((windowM_choice + windowS_choice) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤` and it feeds `b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm` to `DivCarveChartRing`. `univSeed`'s files bind `b2` (`DivRepChartClassUniv.lean:118-120`) as a basis of `divisorSections k ((windowS_choice • F) + (windowM_choice • F)) ⊤` and feed **bare `b2`**. `windowShiftEquiv` (`Picard/DivSchemeClassifyBridge.lean:86-92`) is exactly the `LinearEquiv.ofEq` between those two spellings, built from `add_nsmul`/`add_comm`. So the two `RZ`s are the same ring *provided* the transport aligns — the divisor argument to `DivCarveChartRing` is the same `A B` pair in both, and only the basis argument differs by that reindexing.

That alignment is **not proved anywhere in the tree**, and no declaration connects any of the four `divFamZarUniv*` (`…Univ.lean:213`, `…UnivFree.lean:183`, `…UnivAny.lean:261`, `…UnivZarLocal.lean:287`) to `IsChartClause`. Grepped: `IsChartClause` appears only in `DivRepAffPullClause.lean` and `DivRepChartRange.lean` (which states `isChartClause_iff_forall_classify_eq`, `:186`), never with `univSeed` or `divFamZarUniv`. `DivRepChartClassUniv.lean:67` says so itself: "It produces no certificate, hence no `DivFamZar` over `R_Z` and no `IsChartClause`."

So the answer to the caller's own gating question: `univSeed` is over `DivCarveChartRing … b1 b2 i j`, while U2's `IsChartClause` binds `DivFamZar C (DivCarveChartRing … b1 (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j) pi g`. They are plausibly the same object under a landed reindexing, but nothing in Lean says the family `univSeed` supplies is the family `IsChartClause` quantifies over. Until that rfl (or transport) is measured, a straddling verdict on `univSeed` decides the fate of `divFamZarUniv`, not directly of U2's class half.

**One further correction to the row's framing.** `DivRepChartClassUnivZarLocal.lean:89-105` already argues, and I confirm from the definitions, that "does `univSeed`'s supportLocus meet both V0 and V1?" is the wrong measurement for the *no-go*: `localEquations` builds a pointed cover with one member per point and `side` a function of the point, so per-piece chart confinement (`ThetaGeneratorSeed.piece_le`, `Picard/DivSchemeFamily.lean:98`) is free and global straddling is permitted but not produced. The support-locus question *is* however exactly what `forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling` consumes (`hx`, `hy` are `∈ d.supportLocus` with no piece mentioned), so the row's spelling is the right one for the refutation and the sibling file's `side`-based reframing is the right one only for `isEmpty_chartTyping_of_straddling`. Those are two different theorems and the two files each describe one of them.

```lean
    (relCurve C R).LocalEquations where
  cover := { opens := D.piece, mem_opens := D.mem_piece }
  eqn := D.eqn
```

So the probe's object is `(univSeed …).localEquations (isGenerator_univSeed …)`, which the tree already names: `PointwiseAchiever.univSystem`, `Picard/DivRepChartClassUnivZarLocal.lean:261-264`.

## 6. `ChartRing` vs `univSeed`'s ring — the probe is **not** decision-grade as written

`ChartRing` is **not a global definition**. It is a file-local notation in `Picard/DivRepAffPullClause.lean:98-101`:

```lean
local notation "ChartRing" => fun i j =>
  DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
```

That alignment is **not proved anywhere in the tree**, and no declaration connects any of the four `divFamZarUniv*` (`…Univ.lean:213`, `…UnivFree.lean:183`, `…UnivAny.lean:261`, `…UnivZarLocal.lean:287`) to `IsChartClause`. ## 3. The two straddling theorems, verbatim

`AlgebraicGeometry.forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling`, `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffStrict.lean:127-134`. Section binders at `:109-111`: `{k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom]`, `{R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]`, `{pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]`.

```lean
theorem forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling
    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    (hconn : _root_.IsPreconnected d.supportLocus)
    {x y : relCurve C R} (hx : x ∈ d.supportLocus) (hy : y ∈ d.supportLocus)
    (hx₀ : x ∉ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ : Set (relCurve C R)))
    (hy₁ : y ∉ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ : Set (relCurve C R))) :
    ∀ (A : DivisorAdaptation C R pi d) (n : ℕ), ¬ A.IsCertified n :=
  fun A _ => A.not_isCertified_of_isPreconnected_of_witnesses hconn hx hy hx₀ hy₁
```

The roadmap's "takes its base ring as a SECTION VARIABLE" is accurate — `R` is a section variable, and `d` is implicit, so the schema instantiates at `Localization.Away r` with the pulled system. Its engine is `DivisorAdaptation.not_isCertified_of_isPreconnected_of_witnesses` (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarVerdict.lean:62`), which runs through `supportLocus_subset_chart_of_isCertified` (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarC1.lean:131`) → `supportLocus_subset_chart_of_isPreconnected` (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarConn.lean:149`), whose upgrade step consumes `relCover_sup` (`V₀ ⊔ V₁ = ⊤`).

`AlgebraicGeometry.AffAdaptation.isEmpty_chartTyping_of_straddling`, `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffTheta.lean:658-667`.     {x y : relCurve C R} (hxj : x ∈ D.pieces j) (hyj : y ∈ D.pieces j)
```lean
    (hx₀ : x ∉ ((relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ : Set (relCurve C R)))
```

## 4. `IsLocallyCertified`, `divFamZarSetoid`, `DivFamZar`

`Picard/DivisorFamilyZar.lean:71-80` (binders `:60-62`: `C : Over (Spec (.of k))`, `(R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]`, `(π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsAffineHom π]`):

```lean
def IsLocallyCertified (n : ℕ) (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) : Prop :=
  ∃ (m : ℕ) (g : Fin m → R), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤ ∧
    ∀ i : Fin m,
      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away (g i)) π n,
        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) d))
```

`:224-229` and `:235`:
```lean
def divFamZarSetoid : Setoid {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations //
    IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} where
  r d₁ d₂ := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁.1 d₂.1
  iseqv :=
    ⟨fun d => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl d.1,
     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩

def DivFamZar : Type u := Quotient (divFamZarSetoid C R π n)
```

The `CertifiedDivisorFamily` inside `IsLocallyCertified` is the chart-typed one (it carries a `DivisorAdaptation`, which extends `FinCoverData`), which is why the no-go instantiates at the away ring — as `DivRepChartClassUnivZarLocal.lean:41-47` states, correctly.

## 5. Nothing computes, bounds, or hypothesises `univSeed`'s support relative to the pinned charts

Searched case-insensitively for `straddl`, `supportLocus`, `support`, `univSeed`, `univSystem` across all of `AlgebraicJacobian/`. The complete list of declarations whose name mentions straddling is four: `forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling`, `exists_affAdaptation_isCertified_of_straddling`, `isEmpty_chartTyping_of_straddling`, `side_straddle_gives_chart_separated_pieces`. None mentions `univSeed`. No declaration anywhere takes `univSeed`/`univSystem` and says anything about `supportLocus`. The row's claim stands.

**Two near misses worth pricing before a lane starts, both landed and both about a general seed, hence applicable to `univSeed`:**

- `ThetaGeneratorSeed.exists_matrix_opens_supportLocus_subset_twisted_chartInter` (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarFibreAvoid.lean:355-365`): for **any** generator seed, at any base prime `p`, there is a `GL₂(k)` twist `M` and a base neighbourhood `V ∋ p` with `base⁻¹(V) ∩ (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ⊆ (twistedRelCover C R π M).V₀ ⊓ .V₁`. Proved from the seed's own `fibre_regular` clause — no certificate. It is about `twistedRelCover` (`Cohomology/TwistedFiberTwoCover.lean:81`, `= relCover C R (twistedFiberTwoCover π M)`), not the pinned `fiberTwoCover`, so it does **not** answer the probe; it says the support is chart-confinable after a coordinate change, locally on the base. This is the closest thing in the tree to the measurement, and it cuts *toward* non-straddling in the twisted charts while saying nothing at `M = 1`. Requires `[Infinite k]` (section variable at `:270`).
- `PointwiseAchiever.supportLocus_ncard_residueFibreLocalEquations_pointwiseGeneratorSeed_le` (`Picard/DivSchemeCertZarFibreAvoid.lean:408`): the residue-fibre support of `pointwiseGeneratorSeed` — i.e. of `univSeed` up to the RD-N argument — has `ncard ≤ g` at every prime. A finiteness bound on the fibre support, not a chart comparison. Note its `RZ` is the `seedChartRing` notation (`Picard/DivSchemeRedesignCarvePin.lean:57`), which is an `abbrev` unfolding to the same `DivCarveChartRing` as `DivRepChartClassUniv`'s `RZ`, with `b₂` in the `(windowS + windowM)` spelling — matching.

Also relevant: `IsPreconnected d.supportLocus`, the no-go's first hypothesis, is nowhere established for any seed. So even granting the two witnesses, the refutation needs a third input nobody holds.

## 6. `ChartRing` vs `univSeed`'s ring — the probe is **not** decision-grade as written

`ChartRing` is **not a global definition**. It is a file-local notation in `Picard/DivRepAffPullClause.lean:98-101`:

```lean
local notation "ChartRing" => fun i j =>
  DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j
```

(`DivCarveChartRing` itself: `Picard/DivSchemeFamilyUniv.lean:55`, `abbrev … := PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j ⧸ divCarveIdeal k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j`.) A separate `ChartRing k d r J` in `Picard/GrassmannianScheme.lean` is an unrelated Grassmannian chart ring — different object, same name.

`IsChartClause` (`Picard/DivRepAffPullClause.lean:119-127`) quantifies over `U : ∀ i j, DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g`, i.e. over `DivFamZar C (PairChartRing … ⧸ divCarveIdeal … b1 (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j) pi g`.

**The mismatch:** `DivRepAffPullClause.lean`'s section binder for `b2` (`:89-91`) is a basis of `divisorSections k ((windowM_choice + windowS_choice) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤` and it feeds `b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm` to `DivCarveChartRing`. `univSeed`'s files bind `b2` (`DivRepChartClassUniv.lean:118-120`) as a basis of `divisorSections k ((windowS_choice • F) + (windowM_choice • F)) ⊤` and feed **bare `b2`**. `windowShiftEquiv` (`Picard/DivSchemeClassifyBridge.lean:86-92`) is exactly the `LinearEquiv.ofEq` between those two spellings, built from `add_nsmul`/`add_comm`. So the two `RZ`s are the same ring *provided* the transport aligns — the divisor argument to `DivCarveChartRing` is the same `A B` pair in both, and only the basis argument differs by that reindexing.

That alignment is **not proved anywhere in the tree**, and no declaration connects any of the four `divFamZarUniv*` (`…Univ.lean:213`, `…UnivFree.lean:183`, `…UnivAny.lean:261`, `…UnivZarLocal.lean:287`) to `IsChartClause`. Grepped: `IsChartClause` appears only in `DivRepAffPullClause.lean` and `DivRepChartRange.lean` (which states `isChartClause_iff_forall_classify_eq`, `:186`), never with `univSeed` or `divFamZarUniv`. `DivRepChartClassUniv.lean:67` says so itself: "It produces no certificate, hence no `DivFamZar` over `R_Z` and no `IsChartClause`."

So the answer to the caller's own gating question: `univSeed` is over `DivCarveChartRing … b1 b2 i j`, while U2's `IsChartClause` binds `DivFamZar C (DivCarveChartRing … b1 (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j) pi g`. They are plausibly the same object under a landed reindexing, but nothing in Lean says the family `univSeed` supplies is the family `IsChartClause` quantifies over. Until that rfl (or transport) is measured, a straddling verdict on `univSeed` decides the fate of `divFamZarUniv`, not directly of U2's class half.

**One further correction to the row's framing.** `DivRepChartClassUnivZarLocal.lean:89-105` already argues, and I confirm from the definitions, that "does `univSeed`'s supportLocus meet both V0 and V1?" is the wrong measurement for the *no-go*: `localEquations` builds a pointed cover with one member per point and `side` a function of the point, so per-piece chart confinement (`ThetaGeneratorSeed.piece_le`, `Picard/DivSchemeFamily.lean:98`) is free and global straddling is permitted but not produced. The support-locus question *is* however exactly what `forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling` consumes (`hx`, `hy` are `∈ d.supportLocus` with no piece mentioned), so the row's spelling is the right one for the refutation and the sibling file's `side`-based reframing is the right one only for `isEmpty_chartTyping_of_straddling`. Those are two different theorems and the two files each describe one of them.
